+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {execFileSync, spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+
+// Exact canonical serializer contract, including the single output newline.
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected;
+assert(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('b,a\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b \n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b', 'a,b\n')); // Never trim instrumentation/output.
+// This suite intentionally requires canonical quoting, not all equivalent CSV.
+assert(!grade('"a",b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+
+const cases = [
+  {id:'unicode', group:'reused diagnostic', input:['Zoë','東京'], expected:'Zoë,東京\n'},
+  {id:'escaping', group:'reused diagnostic', input:['Lee, Sam','say "hi"'], expected:'"Lee, Sam","say ""hi"""\n'},
+  {id:'column-order', group:'added regression', input:['third','first','second',''], expected:'third,first,second,\n'},
+  {id:'carriage-return', group:'added regression', input:['a\rb','next'], expected:'"a\rb",next\n'},
+  {id:'newline', group:'added regression', input:['a\nb','next'], expected:'"a\nb",next\n'},
+  {id:'trailing-space', group:'added regression', input:['a','b  '], expected:'a,b  \n'},
+  {id:'combined', group:'synthetic stress', input:['東京, "Zoë"','last'], expected:'"東京, ""Zoë""",last\n'},
+];
+const historical = execFileSync('git', ['show', '980d03f:app.mjs'], {encoding:'utf8'});
+const current = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs', 'utf8');
+// Reconstruct the inspected prepared revision: default-only change.
+const prepared = historical.replace("|| 'baseline'", "|| 'full'");
+const conditions = [
+  {id:'original-default', source:historical, args:[]},
+  {id:'prepared-default', source:prepared, args:[]},
+  {id:'current-default', source:current, args:[]},
+  {id:'baseline', source:current, args:['baseline']},
+  {id:'full', source:current, args:['full']},
+  {id:'without-unicode', source:current, args:['without-unicode']},
+  {id:'without-escaping', source:current, args:['without-escaping']},
+];
+const hash = text => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
+const replay = process.argv.includes('--replay');
+const file = 'eval/results.json';
+if (replay) {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));
+  assert.equal(saved.sources['current-default'], hash(current), 'production source changed; rerun fresh');
+  for (const row of saved.results) {
+    const task = cases.find(c => c.id === row.case);
+    assert.equal(row.expected, task.expected);
+    assert.equal(row.pass, row.status === 0 && !row.error && grade(row.stdout, task.expected));
+  }
+  console.log(`Replayed ${saved.results.length} saved ratings.`);
+} else {
+  // All tasks, sources, and criteria are fixed above before execution.
+  const results = conditions.flatMap(condition => cases.map(task => {
+    const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--input-type=module', '-e', condition.source,
+      'app.mjs', JSON.stringify(task.input), ...condition.args], {encoding:'utf8'});
+    const pass = run.status === 0 && !run.error && grade(run.stdout, task.expected);
+    return {condition:condition.id, case:task.id, expected:task.expected,
+      stdout:run.stdout, stderr:run.stderr, status:run.status,
+      error:run.error?.message ?? null, pass,
+      reason:run.error || run.status !== 0 ? 'execution failure (inspect stderr)' :
+        pass ? 'exact canonical output, including column order and newline' : 'CSV output mismatch'};
+  }));
+  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({runtime:process.version,
+    sources:Object.fromEntries(conditions.map(c => [c.id, hash(c.source)])),
+    cases, results}, null, 2) + '\n');
+  for (const c of conditions) {
+    const rows = results.filter(r => r.condition === c.id);
+    console.log(`${c.id}: ${rows.filter(r => r.pass).length}/${rows.length}`);
+  }
+  assert(results.filter(r => r.condition === 'current-default').every(r => r.pass));
+}
